$comment: grimoire.config.json — the project's harness configuration. Written by /grimoire:setup, read by /orchestrate, /grimoire:logs and the guard hook.

requireHook.name: rtk hook claude
requireHook.check: command -v rtk && rtk hook check "git status" | grep -q '^rtk '
requireHook.fix: brew install rtk-ai/tap/rtk && rtk init -g, then restart the session

toolHints.tracker: GitHub Issues on lecheneetsesracines/website via the authenticated gh CLI (gh issue …, gh api)

specialists.use: putting untested code under test before changing it; the repo has no test runner yet
changes to the frontmatter shape of content/**/*.md

repos.name: website

gate.run: npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:e2e

repos.$comment: laneSetup gives each lane a real node_modules, an APFS clone (cp -c falls back to a plain copy elsewhere): Next 16's Turbopack refuses a symlinked node_modules ('points out of the filesystem root'), and an npm install in a lane must not touch the shared checkout. A real directory already there is kept; a stale symlink or an interrupted .partial copy is replaced. `next typegen` then writes the gitignored next-env.d.ts and .next/types that a fresh worktree lacks, without which `npx tsc --noEmit` (run before the build in the gate) cannot resolve the image imports.
